what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Albania, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4571 Ukrainian refugees in Albania, 0.1% of all refugees from Ukraine.
Germany hosts the most Ukrainian refugees, followed by Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2017 to 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2022 at 2542 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 9250, at the end of 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 and 2024, and the figure was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Albania.
These are year-end totals for Albania only, reported to UNHCR.
